run_add_cam_noise: run the script to add Gaussian rotation noise to camera matrices in a directory
build_cam_noise_augmentation: build a camera augmentation pipeline that adds random rotation noise to 4x4 camera matrices
create_noisy_camera_matrices: create noisy camera matrices by applying Gaussian perturbation to rotation components using Rodrigues formula
refactor_cam_noise_script: refactor the camera noise script to use argparse instead of sys.argv for CLI argument parsing
review_cam_noise_augmentation: review the camera noise augmentation logic that applies random rotation and resets translation to z=3
